en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic riverside view of a historic European city. In the foreground is a wide riverbank and water, while on the opposite side stand dense rows of old buildings, church towers, and a large cathedral or basilica dominating the skyline. On the far right there is an industrial complex with multiple tall chimneys. The sky is filled with large clouds. Along the bottom margin there is a printed caption in Dutch.
